1. Hera Launch

Tagline: Create studio-quality launch videos with AI
Description: Product launch videos used to take weeks. Hera Launch makes them in seconds, from a single prompt. This works because Hera is opinionated. It works like a motion design studio and decides pacing, typography, motion curves, and easing for you. We built it for product teams that want to launch fast and often: 10 minutes from idea to finished video, on a monthly subscription.

Find trending topics in your niche, write scripts with AI, record with our Auto Jump Cut teleprompter, auto-edit with subtitles and B-roll, and publish directly to your socials. One app instead of five. Go from idea to posted video faster.
